# sophosfirewall_firewall_rule (Data Source)

Looks up an existing firewall rule by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sophosfirewall_firewall_rule" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the firewall rule.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Action for matching traffic. One of `accept`, `drop`, `reject`. Defaults to `accept`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `destination_networks` (Attributes) Destination networks. Omit to match any network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination_networks))
- `destination_zones` (Set of String) Destination zones. Omit to match any zone.
- `email_scanning` (Attributes) Email protocols to scan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_scanning))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `exclusions` (Attributes) Traffic excluded from the rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exclusions))
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `log_traffic` (Boolean) Log traffic matching the rule. Defaults to `false`.
- `position` (String) Where to place the firewall rule. One of `top`, `bottom`, `before`, `after`. New rules default to `bottom`. The firewall does not report rule positions, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `position_reference` (String) Name of the firewall rule to place this one `before` or `after`. Required for those positions.
- `qos` (Attributes) Traffic shaping. Ignored for user-based rules, which use the user's policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--qos))
- `schedule` (String) Name of the schedule during which the rule is active. Omit for always.
- `security_features` (Attributes) Security features applied to allowed traffic. Only valid when `action` is `accept`. When `web_policy` is unset and `scan_http_and_decrypted_https` is false, `web_proxy`, `web_category_based_qos_policy`, `block_quic_protocol` and `decrypt_https_web_proxy_mode` must be false. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_features))
- `service_groups` (Set of String) Names of service groups.
- `services` (Set of String) Names of services. Omit both `services` and `service_groups` to match any service.
- `source_networks` (Attributes) Source networks and devices. Omit to match any network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_networks))
- `source_zones` (Set of String) Source zones. Omit to match any zone.
- `synchronized_security_heartbeat` (Attributes) Synchronized Security Heartbeat enforcement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--synchronized_security_heartbeat))
- `user_authentication` (Attributes) Match known users. When set, the rule applies only to authenticated users and their user-based policies apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_authentication))

<a id="nestedatt--qos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `qos`

Read-Only:

- `dscp_marking` (String) DSCP marking as shown by the firewall, e.g. `46-Expedited Forwarding(EF)`.
- `traffic_shaping_policy` (String) Name of the traffic shaping policy.


<a id="nestedatt--security_features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_features`

Read-Only:

- `application_based_qos_policy` (Boolean) Apply application based traffic shaping. Defaults to `false`.
- `application_policy` (String) Name of the application control policy.
- `block_quic_protocol` (Boolean) Block QUIC traffic. Defaults to `false`.
- `decrypt_https_web_proxy_mode` (Boolean) Decrypt HTTPS in web proxy mode. Defaults to `false`.
- `ips_policy` (String) Name of the intrusion prevention policy.
- `scan_ftp` (Boolean) Scan FTP for malware. Defaults to `false`.
- `scan_http_and_decrypted_https` (Boolean) Scan HTTP and decrypted HTTPS. Defaults to `false`.
- `scan_with_ndr_active_threat_intelligence` (Boolean) Scan with NDR active threat intelligence. Defaults to `false`.
- `web_category_based_qos_policy` (Boolean) Apply web category based traffic shaping. Defaults to `false`.
- `web_policy` (String) Name of the web policy.
- `web_proxy` (Boolean) Use the web proxy instead of the DPI engine. Defaults to `false`.
- `zero_day_protection` (Boolean) Use zero-day protection (requires HTTP scanning). Defaults to `false`.

### Nested Schema for `source_networks`

Read-Only:

- `countries` (Set of String) Names of countries.
- `country_groups` (Set of String) Names of country groups.
- `fqdn_addresses` (Set of String) Names of FQDN address objects.
- `fqdn_groups` (Set of String) Names of FQDN groups.
- `ipv4_addresses` (Set of String) Names of IPv4 address objects.
- `ipv4_groups` (Set of String) Names of IPv4 address groups.

<a id="nestedatt--synchronized_security_heartbeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `synchronized_security_heartbeat`

Read-Only:

- `block_destination_without_heartbeat` (Boolean) Block destination clients without a heartbeat. Defaults to `false`.
- `block_source_without_heartbeat` (Boolean) Block source clients without a heartbeat. Defaults to `false`.
- `destination_minimum_level` (String) Minimum heartbeat required from destination devices. One of `noRestriction`, `green`, `yellow`. Defaults to `noRestriction`.
- `source_minimum_level` (String) Minimum heartbeat required from source devices. One of `noRestriction`, `green`, `yellow`. Defaults to `noRestriction`.


<a id="nestedatt--user_authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_authentication`

Read-Only:

- `exclude_from_accounting` (Boolean) Exclude this traffic from user data accounting. Defaults to `false`.
- `user_groups` (Set of String) Names of user groups.
- `users` (Set of String) Names of users. Omit both `users` and `user_groups` to match any known user.
- `web_authentication_for_unknown_users` (Boolean) Use web authentication for unknown users. Defaults to `false`.
